note: Fix for the v4.36.0 canary's exit 139 after #536: Lean v4.36.0's findOLean root cache keeps Names from an import's regions, so withImport now calls resetFindOLeanCache (one findOLean `Init under a changed search path, then the search path restored) before freeRegions. The researcher's inline version became a named helper that rethrows a failed lookup with context, so the run stops (exit 2) before the free. Mini repro: exit 139 on v4.36.0 without the helper, 0 with it on v4.35.0, v4.36.0 and v4.37.0-rc1. One full run each under an 11 GiB cap: v4.35.0 --paranoid, all 44 as expected, max RSS 4,974,688 KiB, 2054 s; v4.36.0 default flags, all 44 as expected, max RSS 5,089,792 KiB, 1719 s; case lines identical to round 2 of #536 (sha256 0cb551e6).
